summary: A direct application of Tensor Principal Component Analysis (TPCA introduced by Babii et al. in 2022) of the intraday stock returns does not yield sensible result due to a combination of small sample, strong intraday heteroskedasticity, and large error. This paper proposes a weighted version of TPCA that can potentially mitigate the issue and preserve the asymptotic properties and test implications of the TPCA.
title: A Weighted Tensor Principal Component Analysis on Intraday Stock Returns

summary: Firm characteristics are key signals for return prediction in machine-learning-based asset pricing, but widespread missingness can hinder their use. While recent studies developed more sophisticated imputation methods, evidence about their value for asset pricing remains mixed. We investigate whether information associated with missing characteristics can be better exploited when the prediction model distinguishes it from information observed directly. We propose a new class of deep learning asset return prediction models -- which we call missingness-aware -- and show that explicitly incorporating information associated with missing characteristics -- which characteristics are missing and how many -- improves out-of-sample return prediction and long-short portfolio performance.
title: Boosting Portfolio Performance with Missingness-Aware Deep Learning
